review_notes: 72 existing definitions in six card files. Local-token checks for alpha-only edits; focused review of structured changes. No new native coverage or gameplay-equivalence claim.

Share Sliver source lifecycle checks while retaining in_play calls, source-player snapshots, cleanup exile behavior and humiliation calls. Elven Rite retains live target counts after counter callbacks. Tidal Warrior retains the AI predicate.

Share the reviewed GFP lifecycle in Grave Pact, Spiteful Prankster and four Khans effects, retaining special detachment early returns, byte-packed flags and GFP-specific return behavior. Existing legacy searches use a found flag without changing callback order.

Chainer activation uses nested predicates with the same graveyard-pointer reloads after legality, mana and timing callbacks. Elsha keeps the initial top-card snapshot and subsequent live deck queries. Retribution preserves its recovered AI early-return behavior.

destroy_auras_attached clears the same 302-int snapshot with sizeof and retains the next-card snapshot before destruction callbacks. Larger Atla, Kels, Volrath, Consulate and sacrifice-selection paths retain their control flow under token substitution. Full audits, inventories and reccmp deferred.
verification_policy: Affected-file hashes and exact token checks for alpha-only edits; focused review for structured edits. Build separately after the combined batch. Inventories and reccmp deferred to a larger checkpoint.
scope: Readability cleanup of existing recovered definitions; no new native coverage or gameplay-equivalence claim.
